title: Privileged path simulations and audit-chain remediation for RBAC v2 and SAML integrations
creator: Aisha Narayanan
description: Summary: This ticket drives remediation work after the latest red-team / pen-test focused on privileged admin flows. The assessment uncovered gaps across RBAC v2 role granularity, SAML assertion lifecycle (replay and stale assertion risk), and audit event correlation for admin actions. The goal is to (1) exercise privileged paths with synthetic simulations, (2) implement rapid fixes for audit-chain and session revocation gaps, and (3) land verification harnesses and alerting so regressions are detected automatically.
background: During the November pen-test, testers demonstrated a set of chained actions that allowed privilege elevation using a combination of stale service-account role bindings, replayed SAML assertions, and missing correlation IDs in audit events. Existing RBAC v2 roles are functionally sufficient but lack enforcement on temporary elevation and time-bound admin sessions. Audit logs are emitted but are difficult to stitch into a single request/trace for forensic use. SSO metadata rotation and session revocation were identified as operational gaps.
severity_findings: F1: SAML assertion replay window allowed — testers were able to reuse signed assertion packets within a 10 minute window due to lax nonce handling (severity: critical)
F2: Admin session revocation absent — revoking user roles in the console does not actively revoke existing long-lived sessions (severity: high)
F3: Audit events lack cross-cutting request_id — admin actions emitted without a stable correlation id across services, hampering investigations (severity: high)
F4: Coarse RBAC bindings — several service accounts and groups have broad admin_* permissions; no temporary elevation flow or just-in-time controls (severity: medium)
F5: SIEM forwarding gaps — audit logs for critical admin routes are not consistently forwarded to the SIEM within SLA windows (severity: medium)
F6: SCIM sync lag — stale group memberships persisted for up to 24 hours causing window for unintended access (severity: low/medium)
F7: Missing automated regression tests for privileged flows (severity: medium)
remediation_plan: Task A: Implement SAML assertion nonce binding and explicit single-use tokens — add assertion ID tracking and reject duplicates (owner: auth-service, estimate: 3)
Task B: Add a session revocation API and propagation hooks — revoke token cache, notify edge proxies, invalidate KV cache entries (owner: session-service, estimate: 5)
Task C: Inject a stable correlation_id into every admin request path — propagate through proxies, router, runtime, and audit publisher (owner: gateway+runtime, estimate: 3)
Task D: Create a temporary elevation (JIT) workflow for high-privilege actions — require MFA and time-bound tokens (owner: rbac-service, estimate: 5)
Task E: Harden role bindings audit — add metadata to role-change events, include prior binding snapshot and actor identity (owner: auth+console, estimate: 2)
Task F: Improve SIEM forwarding SLA and add end-to-end observability for critical audit topics (owner: observability, estimate: 2)
Task G: Add deterministic e2e regression tests and nightly privileged-path simulations to the CI/hardening pipeline (owner: qa, estimate: 3)
Task H: Reduce SCIM sync lag and add an emergency invalidate endpoint to purge stale memberships (owner: identity-sync, estimate: 3)
Task I: Update runbooks and incident playbooks to include steps for assertion rotation, session revocation, and audit integrity checks (owner: SRE, estimate: 1)
Task J: Schedule a verification red-team run after fixes (owner: security-eng, estimate: 2)
Task K: Coordinate customer-facing communications for any tenants impacted by forced session invalidation (owner: success+comm, estimate: 1)
Task L: Perform key rotation for SAML signing keys with cross-checks and staged rollout (owner: idp-ops, estimate: 2)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: SAML assertion replay attempts are rejected in staging and production - verified with replay tests (evidence: test logs)
AC-2: Session revocation API invalidates tokens within 15s across edge caches in test region (evidence: latency histograms)
AC-3: Every admin-level audit event contains stable correlation_id and prior-binding snapshot (evidence: sample events in logging UI)
AC-4: JIT elevation flow requires MFA and issues time-limited admin tokens (evidence: e2e test flows)
AC-5: SIEM receives critical admin events within pipeline SLA and alerts fire for anomalous privilege escalations (evidence: SIEM alerts)
AC-6: Nightly privileged-path simulation runs in CI and any regression creates failing test and automated issue (evidence: CI run history)
AC-7: Runbooks updated and validated by SRE and Security teams (sign-off by security-eng)
AC-8: Post-remediation red-team confirms no replay/privilege chaining within allowed windows (evidence: red-team report)
AC-9: Documentation and customer comms drafted for forced session invalidation scenarios (evidence: draft docs link)
AC-10: Security review completed and ticket closed after verification (evidence: security review note)
qa_and_verification: Create synthetic user journeys that exercise: standard admin UI changes, API-based role changes, service-account flows, and SCIM sync disruptions
Replay attack harness that submits captured assertions and expects rejection
Nightly job that toggles temporary elevation for a test user and verifies token expiry and audit emission
Golden-file sampling: store canonical audit-chains and run diff against emitted chains to detect missing fields
Add a check in CI to assert correlation_id presence for all requests to /admin/* endpoints
Run a staged SIEM ingestion test that injects synthetic critical events and asserts pipeline latency < 60s
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Deploy assertion-binder and session-revoke endpoints to canary and run smoke tests (small percentage of traffic)
Phase 1: Enable SAML nonce enforcement and correlation_id injection in canary; monitor error budget and audit integrity metrics for 72 hours
Phase 2: Open JIT elevation behind feature flag for internal users only; collect UX and telemetry
Phase 3: Ramp JIT and session revocation to all regions; execute key rotation in parallel with staged trust ladders
Phase 4: Run full red-team verification and switch feature flag to GA after signoff
monitoring_and_alerting: New alerts: assertion-replay-rate > 0.1% over baseline in 5m -> P0
Audit-chain-integrity: daily job reports missing correlation ids > 0 -> PagerDuty
Privileged-action-anomaly: unusual spike in admin creates/deletes -> Security alert
rollback_strategy: If canary error budget exceeded, revert correlation_id injection and assertion strictness to prior safe mode while keeping session-revoke API available in passive mode
If session revocation causes mass user disruptions, provide a temporary allowlist and quick re-provision pipeline to unfreeze affected service accounts
Key rotation: keep previous key in trust store for 24h and support dual-validation during rollout
runbook_updates: Update: admin-access-revocation.md with new session-revoke API examples
Update: incident-playbook.md to include assertion replay detection and mitigation steps
Add: audit-chain-forensics.md with instructions to reconstruct an admin action across services
